create_eval_mlp_head: create a LinearEvalMLP classification head with BatchNorm2d and configurable MLP layers for feature evaluation
build_eval_mlp_fsdp: build an FSDP-wrapped LinearEvalMLP head with automatic batch norm wrapping for distributed training
test_linear_eval_forward: test the LinearEvalMLP forward pass with 4D and 2D input tensors
refactor_eval_mlp_residual: refactor LinearEvalMLP to use MLPResidual instead of MLP for residual connections
review_eval_mlp_registration: review the eval_mlp and eval_mlp_fsdp model head registrations with register_model_head decorator
